label: B25-BOARD-RUNNER-TRANSPORT-SEAL
title: Build and remotely validate a parameterized board runner bundle without hardware access
triggered_by: T-033 stopped before preflight because an inline PowerShell parser pipeline was split by the Windows command layer; hardware invocation counts remained zero.
scope: Create a task-ID/root-parameterized runner bundle for the next single-attempt board task. Validate local Bash/Python syntax, bootstrap a fresh GamePC task root through an uploaded PowerShell -File script, upload the exact bundle, verify local/remote hashes, and parse every PowerShell file through an uploaded validate_scripts.ps1 invoked with pwsh -File. Perform no JTAG, hardware, programmer, terminal or process-enumeration action.

bundle_contract.parameterization: No consumer task ID or consumer remote root is hardcoded. TaskRoot, TaskId, output roots and run labels are arguments; frozen candidate/golden identities may remain constants.
bundle_contract.single_use: program_once.ps1 implements durable task-root candidate/golden marker guards and refuses a second invocation before quartus_pgm; run_board_once.sh contains no retry loop or replacement-upload path.
bundle_contract.identity: Implements the adopted T-032 exact programmer plus pre-input candidate-unique startup contract and retains all paced/RX/golden gates.
bundle_contract.transport: All remote PowerShell entrypoints use pwsh.exe -File with uploaded files. Inline -Command pipelines, stdin scripts and shell-sensitive PowerShell expressions are forbidden.

acceptance.freshness: Remote validation root and bootstrap file must not preexist; do not delete or overwrite them.
acceptance.local: bash -n, Python py_compile and JSON manifest checks pass; bundle has a deterministic per-file SHA256 manifest.
acceptance.remote: Under gamepc lock, upload bootstrap to the existing build parent, invoke it with pwsh -File to create root/incoming, upload the exact bundle, then invoke validate_scripts.ps1 and verify_seal.ps1 only through pwsh -File. Every PowerShell AST parse has zero errors and every remote hash equals local.
acceptance.parameter_audit: Search proves no T-034/T-035 consumer task ID or consumer root is hardcoded in reusable bundle files; all hardware commands reside only behind normal execution paths and are not invoked by validation.
acceptance.single_use_audit: Static review proves candidate/golden marker creation precedes each programmer call and no second call/retry/reconnect path exists.
acceptance.artifact: Record bundle manifest/hash, remote AST result/hash, exact transport commands and a consumer handoff for a new board task.
acceptance.boundary: No jtagconfig, quartus_pgm, nios2-terminal, custom/standard jtagserver start/stop/query, FPGA configuration, Flash, reset or power.

resource: Every GamePC filesystem/parser action holds resource-lock gamepc. No heavy EDA process is started. Event-driven completion; no subagent polling.
forbidden_regions: JTAG/hardware/process enumeration, programmer, terminal, FPGA configuration, synthesis/fitter/STA/assembler
JIC/EPCQ/Flash, reset, power or process termination
inline PowerShell -Command pipelines or stdin execution
hardcoded next-task ID/root in reusable bundle
retry loops, script replacement after seal or more than one programmer path per mode

dispatch.monitoring: event-driven; one-hour maximum wait; no frequent polling

result.blocker: immutable first remote bootstrap used unsupported Split-Path -LiteralPath/-Parent parameter set; remote root remained absent
result.next: new fresh no-hardware transport task using the corrected local bundle
